Step: 03-16-1487 minus 347 days.  
1487 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From Mar 16 back 347 days:  
Go back 15 days → Mar 1, 1487.  
From Mar 1 back 332 more days:  
Feb 1487: 28 days (common year) → back 28 days → Feb 1, 1487.  
Remaining: 332 - 28 = 304 days to go back into 1486.  
1486 is common year, days before Feb 1, 1486: Jan (31) + rest of 1486 from Dec 31 backward.  
Better: Count days from Mar 16, 1486 to Mar 16, 1487 = 365 days.  
347 days before Mar 16, 1487 = Mar 16, 1486 plus (365 - 347) = 18 days after Mar 16, 1486.  
Mar 16, 1486 + 18 days = Apr 3, 1486.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1486-04-03
